mapper.sql: student.id, student.student_name, student_user.username AS student_account, current_class.organization_id AS current_class_id, current_class_organization.organization_name AS current_class_name

LEFT JOIN sys_user student_user ON student_user.id=student.student_user_id LEFT JOIN edu_student_organization current_class ON current_class.student_id=student.id AND current_class.relation_type='CLASS' AND current_class.status='ACTIVE' AND current_class.organization_id=(SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(candidate.organization_id) END FROM edu_student_organization candidate JOIN sys_organization candidate_org ON candidate_org.id=candidate.organization_id WHERE candidate.student_id=student.id AND candidate.relation_type='CLASS' AND candidate.status='ACTIVE' AND candidate_org.status='ENABLED' AND candidate_org.effective_status='ENABLED'
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization context_org WHERE context_org.id=#{organizationId} AND candidate_org.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(context_org.organization_path,'%'))
AND candidate.organization_id IN #{id}
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization_admin candidate_admin JOIN sys_organization admin_org ON admin_org.id=candidate_admin.organization_id WHERE candidate_admin.user_id=#{userId} AND candidate_org.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(admin_org.organization_path,'%')) ) LEFT JOIN sys_organization current_class_organization ON current_class_organization.id=current_class.organization_id

LEFT JOIN sys_user student_user ON student_user.id = student.student_user_id LEFT JOIN edu_student_organization current_class ON current_class.student_id = student.id AND current_class.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND current_class.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN sys_organization current_class_organization ON current_class_organization.id = current_class.organization_id
mapper.select:
SELECT , parent_student.relation_role AS relationship_role FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_parent_student parent_student ON parent_student.student_id = student.id AND parent_student.parent_user_id = #{userId} AND parent_student.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED'
AND student.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id

SELECT DISTINCT , NULL AS relationship_role FROM edu_student student
WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization scoped_relation JOIN sys_organization scoped_organization ON scoped_organization.id = scoped_relation.organization_id AND scoped_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND scoped_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE scoped_relation.student_id = student.id AND scoped_relation.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization_admin organization_admin JOIN sys_organization administrator_root ON administrator_root.id = organization_admin.organization_id WHERE organization_admin.user_id = #{userId} AND administrator_root.status = 'ENABLED' AND administrator_root.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND scoped_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(administrator_root.organization_path, '%') ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization filter_organization WHERE filter_organization.id = #{organizationId} AND filter_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND filter_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND ( (filter_organization.organization_type = 'CLASS' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization class_relation WHERE class_relation.student_id = student.id AND class_relation.organization_id = filter_organization.id AND class_relation.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND class_relation.status = 'ACTIVE' )) OR (filter_organization.organization_type <> 'CLASS' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization filter_relation JOIN sys_organization relation_organization ON relation_organization.id = filter_relation.organization_id AND relation_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND relation_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE filter_relation.student_id = student.id AND filter_relation.status = 'ACTIVE' AND relation_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(filter_organization.organization_path, '%') )) ) )
AND student.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id

SELECT DISTINCT , NULL AS relationship_role FROM edu_student student
JOIN edu_teacher_class teacher_class ON teacher_class.teacher_user_id = #{userId} AND teacher_class.class_organization_id = current_class.organization_id AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND current_class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND current_class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED'
AND current_class.organization_id = #{organizationId}
AND student.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id

SELECT DISTINCT teacher.id AS user_id, teacher.display_name, teacher_class.class_organization_id FROM sys_user teacher LEFT JOIN edu_teacher_class teacher_class ON teacher_class.teacher_user_id = teacher.id AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization teacher_class_organization JOIN sys_organization administrator_root ON teacher_class_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(administrator_root.organization_path, '%') JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.organization_id = administrator_root.id WHERE teacher_class_organization.id = teacher_class.class_organization_id AND teacher_class_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND teacher_class_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND administrator_root.status = 'ENABLED' AND administrator_root.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND organization_admin.user_id = #{userId} ) WHERE teacher.status = 'ENABLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_teacher_profile teacher_profile WHERE teacher_profile.user_id = teacher.id AND teacher_profile.status = 'ENABLED' AND teacher.user_type = 'ORGANIZATION' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization teacher_membership JOIN sys_organization teacher_organization ON teacher_organization.id = teacher_membership.organization_id JOIN sys_organization administrator_root ON teacher_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(administrator_root.organization_path, '%') JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.organization_id = administrator_root.id WHERE teacher_membership.user_id = teacher.id AND teacher_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND teacher_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND administrator_root.status = 'ENABLED' AND administrator_root.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND organization_admin.user_id = #{userId} )
AND teacher.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY teacher.display_name, teacher.id, teacher_class.class_organization_id

SELECT DISTINCT , NULL AS relationship_role FROM edu_student student WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization scoped_relation JOIN sys_organization scoped_organization ON scoped_organization.id = scoped_relation.organization_id WHERE scoped_relation.student_id = student.id AND scoped_relation.status = 'ACTIVE' AND scoped_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND scoped_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' AND scoped_relation.organization_id IN #{id} ) OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization any_class WHERE any_class.student_id=student.id AND any_class.relation_type='CLASS' AND any_class.status='ACTIVE' AND any_class.organization_id IN #{id}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization placement JOIN sys_organization placement_org ON placement_org.id=placement.organization_id WHERE placement.user_id=student.student_user_id AND placement_org.organization_type IN ('GRADE','CAMPUS') AND placement_org.status='ENABLED' AND placement_org.effective_status='ENABLED' AND placement.organization_id IN #{id} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization enroll JOIN sys_organization school ON school.id=enroll.organization_id WHERE enroll.student_id=student.id AND enroll.relation_type='ENROLLMENT' AND enroll.status='ACTIVE' AND school.status='ENABLED' AND school.effective_status='ENABLED' AND placement_org.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(school.organization_path,'%'))))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization filtered_relation JOIN sys_organization filtered_organization ON filtered_organization.id = filtered_relation.organization_id JOIN sys_organization filter_root ON filter_root.id = #{organizationId} WHERE filtered_relation.student_id = student.id AND filtered_relation.status = 'ACTIVE' AND filtered_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(filter_root.organization_path, '%') ) OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization current_class WHERE current_class.student_id=student.id AND current_class.relation_type='CLASS' AND current_class.status='ACTIVE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization candidate_class JOIN sys_organization candidate_root ON candidate_root.id=#{organizationId} WHERE candidate_class.id=current_class.organization_id AND candidate_class.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(candidate_root.organization_path,'%'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization filter_membership JOIN sys_organization placement ON placement.id=filter_membership.organization_id JOIN sys_organization filter_root ON filter_root.id=#{organizationId} WHERE filter_membership.user_id=student.student_user_id AND placement.organization_type IN ('CAMPUS','GRADE') AND placement.status='ENABLED' AND placement.effective_status='ENABLED' AND placement.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(filter_root.organization_path,'%')))) AND student.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id

AND teacher.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY teacher.display_name, teacher.id, teacher_class.class_organization_id
